A15_large_int_jcs.comment: RC2 regression. Input token 36101157879172420000 parses to the binary64 value whose exact mathematical integer is 36101157879172419584, but ECMAScript Number::toString (JCS) serializes it as 36101157879172420000 (shortest round-trip). Implementations MUST use ECMAScript serialization, not arbitrary-precision int().

nesting_depth.comment: Nesting-depth vectors (RC3). U strings are exact JCS bytes; envelope = U + id + sig appended. Signatures are RFC 8032 test-key signatures over SPP/1/assertion\0 || D; OpenSSL and impl-a agree.
